text:
marta: Heads up — I'm running a preview of the config-sweeper job that will auto-prune runtime keys with no observed usage in 90d. Sending to ops/console/devex for telemetry + UX ack before we flip to dry-run=false. :eyes:

tyler: Nice. Does the sweep remove keys that are only referenced by console previews / dry-run exports?

marta: Good question. Current plan: we consider an event "config.lookup" from the runtime and console-preview hits as usage. Anything only seen in UI drafts without a live lookup gets flagged but not deleted unless explicitly safelisted.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] preview job started: config-sweeper-preview/2024-04-03T14:20Z. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/9876 :robot_face:

sanjay: Telemetry plan looks ok but we need richer delete-plan diffs. We should emit a sample of the planned deletes so product owners can review before removal. Suggest event names: `config_sweeper.preview.started`, `config_sweeper.preview.item` (sampled), `config_sweeper.preview.completed`.

jess: UX request: show a Console banner for affected owners with a 7-day reclaim window. We had a few complaints when keys vanished during experiments last time. Banner should link to the delete-plan diff and a one-click safelist.

omar: +1 on banner. Also add an override label `no-auto-prune` that operators and service teams can add to prevent accidental removal (we should document in the runbook).

marta: Will add `no-auto-prune` and the 7-day banner flow. For the telemetry sampling: plan to sample 1% for items with < 3 lookups/month and 100% for anything > 30d old with zero lookups. Example preview payload (sent to telemetry):

```
{
  "event": "config_sweeper.preview.item",
  "key": "payments.feature_toggle.new-routing-v2",
  "last_seen": "2023-12-01T08:12:00Z",
  "lookups_last_90d": 0,
  "safelist": false,
  "owner": "payments-service"
}
```

devex: Remind me — how will the console surface owners? Do we use the tenant metadata or a new owner field? If owner missing, who gets the banner?

marta: We'll first use `owner` from metadata; fallback to the service that created the key (from audit trail). If still missing, default to `platform-ops` and send a consolidated owner digest to the shared inbox.

sanjay: Edge case: ad-hoc ephemeral flags created by experiments often only show lookups during rollout and then none afterwards. Can we treat keys younger than 30d as ineligible for deletion?

marta: Yes — policy: only consider keys older than 60d for deletion candidates, and we surface 30–60d items in the preview with a "young but unused" flag so teams can be proactive.

tyler: Any rate/scale concerns? Sweeper will scan millions of keys in the config store. We should cap preview runs and use cursored iteration + backoff.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] scheduled-maintenance-window: preview job will limit to 10k keys/hour during initial rollout.

omar: Also recommend adding a safepoint snapshot so we can fast-rollback any accidental deletes. Snapshot + tombstone retention 14d.

marta: Plan recap I'll add to the PR: 1) preview-only run emits sampled telemetry and delete-plan diffs 2) Console shows owner banners + 7-day reclaim link 3) `no-auto-prune` label prevents deletion 4) items <60d are excluded from deletion, 30–60d flagged in preview 5) deletion requires snapshot + tombstone 14d 6) rollout gated by ops & devex ack.

jess: Sounds good. Can you post the PR link and a short checklist for DevEx to review the banner copy?

marta: Yup — PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/config-sweeper/pull/312. Checklist will be in the PR description. I'll wait for thumbs up from ops/devex before switching dry-run=false. :thumbsup:

tyler: ack from infra side, will look at rate limits and iteration strategy in PR comments.

sanjay: ack from telemetry side, will add the event schema to the telemetry repo and wire sampling rules.

omar: ack from ops, please include runbook play for emergency-undelete.

devex: ack on banner UX; will propose copy in the PR.

marta: closing loop — will hold deletion for 72h after final ack and do a smoke run of the preview in canary prod first. Thanks all.
